description: This PHP source file defines the ThemeModel class within the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding API module. The class implements a model for the theme configuration, including properties like colors, images, and social media visibility, and provides functionality to serialize this model to an array, incorporating associated filenames for images.

classes.name: ThemeModel
classes.description: A model representing the theme configuration for the corporate branding API, capable of serializing theme properties including colors and images into an array format for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ThemeModel instance with a PartialTheme entity, setting attribute filters and names for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the ThemeModel to an array, including associated filenames for logo, banner, and login banner if available.
